name: ps-diff
description: Protocol-diff harness: feeds the same command stream to pokemon-showdown's BattleStream and to ps_sim_cli, diffs the output line by line. Own install, pinned to upstream master c0845f33 (2026-10-23), the phase R re-sync (docs/architecture/showdown-resync.md). No npm release exists past 0.11.11, so the pin is a git commit and postinstall builds dist/.
